title: Repeat-Error Uplift on Refunds of Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Credit Balances
content:
**Clause.** On a refund of the credit balance left on an ended Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan, the repeat-error uplift adds interest of the credit balance multiplied by the uplift and by the refund's late days, divided by 365. The repeat-error uplift is 0.02 a year when the plan carries two or more billing-error corrections, 0.01 when it carries exactly one, and nothing when it carries none.

| Billing-error corrections on the plan's fee ledger (all dates) | Repeat-error uplift (a year) |
| --- | --- |
| two or more | 0.02 |
| exactly one | 0.01 |
| none | nothing |

**Points of reading.** Every billing-error correction on the plan counts, whatever its date. Free-look refund credits are not billing-error corrections.

**Hypothetical cases.** A plan with three billing-error corrections takes 0.02; with one billing-error correction and one free-look refund credit it takes 0.01; with only a free-look refund credit it takes nothing.
